message.content:
Below is a **ready‑to‑copy** overview of the *public holidays* that create “extra” days off (a true long‑weekend) anywhere in Canada during 2023.  
I’ve grouped the events by month, listed their exact dates, noted the day of the week, and highlighted how the holiday turns a normal weekend into a three‑day break.  

> ⚠️ **Provincial variations:** Some holidays exist only in specific provinces (e.g., Family Day, St. Patricks’ Day, Natal Day, etc.). Where a holiday is *not* nationwide, I marked the relevant provinces in brackets. If your users live outside those areas, simply ignore the row.

| Month | Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Provinces / Territories affected | How it becomes a long‑weekend |
|-------|---------|-------------|--------------|-----------------------------------|-------------------------------|
| **Jan** | New Year’s Day (Observed) | Mon Feb 02 | Monday | All except Nunavut (no statutory holiday) | Adds a single paid day between the regular weekend (Sat–Sun) → **Fri‑Mon** long‑weekend. |
| **Feb** | Family Day | Mon Feb 20 | Monday | AB, SK, ON, MB, NB, NL, PE, QC (named differently in some) | Holiday on Monday ⇒ **Fri‑Mon** long‑weekend. |
|       | St. Patrick’s Day | Wed Mar 08 | Wednesday | NB, PE, NS, NT, YT | Falls mid‑week → **Wed‑Fri** long‑weekend. |
| **Apr** | Good Friday | Fri Apr 07 | Friday | All except B.C. (where it’s a bank holiday) | Friday holiday → **Fri‑Sun** long‑weekend. |
|       | Easter Monday | Mon Apr 10 | Monday | Federal employees, some banks | Monday holiday → **Fri‑Mon** long‑weekend. |
| **May** | Victoria Day | Mon May 29 | Monday | All except N.W.T./Yukon/Nunavut (they observe Memorial Day instead) | Monday holiday → **Fri‑Mon** long‑weekend. |
| **Jun** | National Indigenous Peoples Day | Mon Jun 18 | Monday | BC, Yukon, Northwest Territories | Monday holiday → **Fri‑Mon** long‑weekend. |
| **Jul** | Canada Day (Observed) | Mon Jul 03 | Monday | All except Nunavut | Observed Monday because original holiday fell on Saturday → **Fri‑Mon** long‑weekend. |
| **Sep** | Labour Day | Mon Sep 04 | Monday | All except Nunavut | Monday holiday → **Fri‑Mon** long‑weekend. |
| **Oct** | Thanksgiving | Mon Oct 09 | Monday | All except Nunavut | Monday holiday → **Fri‑Mon** long‑weekend. |
| **Nov** | Remembrance Day (Observed) | Thu Nov 10 | Thursday | Most provinces (BC, AB, SK, MB, NB, NL, PE, NS, NU, NT, YT); omitted in ON, QC, NB, PE, NS, YT? | Thursday holiday → **Thu‑Fri** long‑weekend. |
| **Dec** | Christmas | Mon Dec 25 | Monday | All except Nunavut | Monday holiday → **Fri‑Mon** long‑weekend. |
|       | Boxing Day | Tue Dec 26 | Tuesday | All except Nunavut | Tuesday holiday → **Tue‑Wed** short break (often combined with Christmas for a longer stretch). |

### Quick Reference Cheat Sheet

```
• Mondays that are holidays → Fri‑Mon long‑weekends
• Fridays that are holidays   → Fri‑Sun long‑weekends
• Thursdays that are holidays → Thu‑Fri long‑weekends
```

#### Example Calendar View (for Ontario)

```text
┌───────┬───────────────────────────────┐
│Month │Holiday                        │
├───────┼───────────────────────────────┤
│Feb    │Family Day – Mon 20            │
│Apr    │Good Friday – Fri 7           │
│        │Easter Monday – Mon 10         │
│May    │Victoria Day – Mon 29          │
│Jul    │Canada Day (Obs.) – Mon 3      │
│Sep    │Labour Day – Mon 4             │
│Oct    │Thanksgiving – Mon 9           │
│Dec    │Christmas – Mon 25             │
└───────┴───────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Integrating Into Your App

If you’re building a holiday planner UI, consider adding:

1. **A toggle** to show/hide provincial-specific holidays.
2. A **“Longest Breaks” filter** that highlights weeks containing ≥ 2 consecutive non‑workdays.
3. An optional **calendar overlay** that shades entire long‑weekend periods.

Feel free to copy/paste the tables above directly into Markdown, CSV, JSON, or whatever format suits your backend!
